items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: It should be something like Ronny, time.

ctx.x: I'm a person to tell you, if you ask him. Recently or? Oh, quite a while back.
Ten years? I think something like that. It should be something like Ronny, time.
Well who played with Jack Carey? Who was some of the other guys?
